The translated BitField::BIT_LENGTH constant returns its declared width normally. Arbitrary element type, width and finite slice on x86_64; success and integer-overflow failure are both specified for the product.

The BitField constant returns its declared width normally, and per-element get_bit/set_bit satisfy the explicit normal-return observation/update contracts at valid local indices. Arbitrary type, slice, index and set boolean; zero-width and out-of-bounds failures are also specified. This is a callback-conditional composition proof, not a body proof of arbitrary downstream implementations.
